result.title: Segmentation-Guided Direct Capacity Estimation of Rooftop Photovoltaics from Aerial Imagery
result.summary: Distribution planners need installation-level inventories of rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity, but interconnection records may be incomplete or spatially aggregated. Conventional image-based estimators segment PV arrays, convert the mask to physical area, and multiply by an estimated power density, coupling capacity prediction to mask-derived area. We propose Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing nonnegative capacity from PV-region features and area descriptors. We evaluate three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations under the original split and a department-based holdout. Relative to a parameter-matched area-density neural model, Direct Head reduces mean absolute error by 8.7% and 12.5%, and symmetric mean absolute percentage error by 14.0% and 20.7%, respectively. Comparisons with conventional estimators, controlled architecture variants, auxiliary-loss ablations, and representative cases show that segmentation provides useful spatial evidence without requiring capacity to be determined by an area-density product.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究如何从航拍影像估计屋顶光伏装机容量，提出 Direct Head：保留 U-Net 分割与软掩码池化，同时由光伏区域特征和面积描述符直接回归非负容量，避免把容量绑定为面积与功率密度之积。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于遥感分割加回归的常规任务应用，没有涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部状态、证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，软掩码池化仅为任务特定特征池化，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
